meaning:
κατηγορία, -ας, ἡ
(κατήγορος),
an accusation, charge: with genitive of person(s), Jhn.18:29; before κατά, with id., 1Ti.5:19; with genitive of thing(s), Tit.1:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
Don’t receive an accusation against an elder, except at the word of two or three witnesses.
if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
